svg.title: SEP reset distribution
svg.desc: Reset distribution inside the SEP. Boundary inputs enter on the left and the watchdog reset request leaves on the right. In u_sep_efuse_wrapper, part of u_sep_crypto, rst_ni, ext_boot_seq_done_i and fuse-sense done are ANDed and synchronised into sep_intermediate_reset_n. In u_sep_reset_ctrl the JTAG IC_RESET override mux and the 2-flop u_sep_reset_sync turn it into sep_reset_n; sep_cpu_reset_n is sep_reset_n ANDed with wdt_rst_ni, then a scan bypass. For each of the seven SW_RESET_N bits, an isolate sequencer output is ANDed with sep_reset_n, passed through a JTAG IP override mux fed by synchronised override bits, then a scan bypass, forming sep_crypto_gated_rst_n. In test mode scan_rst_ni replaces each output. sep_reset_n resets the Key Manager cold domain, the system peripherals, the SPI host, the DMA and the SRAM and boot ROM interfaces. sep_cpu_reset_n resets the EL2 core and the warm scratch registers. The gated resets reach the TRNG, OTBN, AES, HMAC, KMAC, Adams Bridge and the Key Manager warm domain. rst_ni resets the crypto interconnect, life cycle controller, eFuse shim mux, alert receivers, encoders, EDN AXIS adapters, the TRNG power-on reset, the watchdog, the local crossbar, the eFuse shim demux and the entropy pool. dbg_rstb_i and jtag_trst_ni reset the EL2 debug module and JTAG TAP.
svg.text: Test mode: scan_rst_ni replaces the u_sep_reset_sync and scan bypass outputs
